shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a blue shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat and proposes sharing breakfast with a neighbor, a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the patio-side window seat, and a man in a purple shirt sits in the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt and the woman in a yellow shirt exchange seats, and she agrees to the plan.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt explains the plan.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the dining table.
